# How do vendors register?

Sellers can become vendors in a few ways. The store owner controls approval.

- **Vendor menu** → *Register* on the vendor registration page.
- **Seller Central page** → **Become a Seller**.
- **My Account sign-up** (if the admin enables it) → choose **"I am a Vendor"** to reveal vendor fields.
- **Existing customer** → **Become a Vendor** from the My Account panel.

The form collects email, password, name, **Shop Name**, **Shop URL** (checked live for availability), phone, and terms acceptance. Full walkthrough: [Vendor Registration Process](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-registration-process.html).

::: tip Still need help?
Shop URL rejected for every value? See [Shop URL "Already Exists"](../troubleshooting/shop-url-already-exists.html).
:::
